hypothesis_claim: Appending exactly this instruction — 'Use round-robin coverage passes: first remove every stub and implement the smallest specification-valid path in every module; only then revisit modules in descending risk to add boundary and error clauses, never polishing one module while another required behavior remains wholly unimplemented.' — will increase all-modules held-out pass rate under a fixed deadline relative to no appended instruction.
baseline_description: Agent defaults: identical prompt, model, tools, and limits with no appended system prompt.
intervention: Use round-robin coverage passes: first remove every stub and implement the smallest specification-valid path in every module; only then revisit modules in descending risk to add boundary and error clauses, never polishing one module while another required behavior remains wholly unimplemented.
